test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the sister of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

If A % G & H # B @ Z % M, then how is H related to M?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 %
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Father
 Sister
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: A % G & H # B @ Z % M

It means: A is the Sister of G, G is the Daughter of H, H is the Wife of B, B is the Father of Z, Z is the Sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b98803606f77e71b2ff64ae54c5e44f3f3306aa1faca0fcc1119ec2e59f739e.png] 

So, H is the '**Mother**' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
